title: Detailed piano
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Piano body -->
  <rect x="10" y="30" width="80" height="50" rx="6" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <rect x="12" y="32" width="76" height="46" rx="4" fill="#A0522D"/>
  
  <!-- Top lid -->
  <rect x="8" y="24" width="84" height="10" rx="4" fill="#6B3410"/>
  <rect x="10" y="26" width="80" height="6" rx="2" fill="#8B4513"/>
  
  <!-- Music stand -->
  <rect x="35" y="14" width="30" height="12" rx="2" fill="#D2B48C"/>
  <rect x="37" y="16" width="26" height="8" rx="1" fill="#F5DEB3"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="18" x2="60" y2="18" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="20" x2="60" y2="20" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="22" x2="60" y2="22" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- White keys row -->
  <rect x="14" y="48" width="72" height="14" rx="2" fill="#F0F0F0"/>
  
  <!-- White key separators (light purple shading) -->
  <line x1="22" y1="48" x2="22" y2="62" stroke="#C8C8E0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="48" x2="30" y2="62" stroke="#C8C8E0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="38" y1="48" x2="38" y2="62" stroke="#C8C8E0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="46" y1="48" x2="46" y2="62" stroke="#C8C8E0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="48" x2="54" y2="62" stroke="#C8C8E0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="62" y1="48" x2="62" y2="62" stroke="#C8C8E0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="70" y1="48" x2="70" y2="62" stroke="#C8C8E0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="78" y1="48" x2="78" y2="62" stroke="#C8C8E0" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Black keys (deep purple, lit) -->
  <rect x="18" y="46" width="5" height="9" rx="1" fill="#4B0082"/>
  <rect x="26" y="46" width="5" height="9" rx="1" fill="#4B0082"/>
  <rect x="42" y="46" width="5" height="9" rx="1" fill="#4B0082"/>
  <rect x="50" y="46" width="5" height="9" rx="1" fill="#4B0082"/>
  <rect x="58" y="46" width="5" height="9" rx="1" fill="#4B0082"/>
  <rect x="66" y="46" width="5" height="9" rx="1" fill="#4B0082"/>
  <rect x="74" y="46" width="5" height="9" rx="1" fill="#4B0082"/>
  
  <!-- Key front panel -->
  <rect x="14" y="62" width="72" height="4" rx="1" fill="#D2B48C"/>
  
  <!-- Decorative panel -->
  <rect x="14" y="66" width="72" height="10" rx="2" fill="#6B3410"/>
  <rect x="18" y="68" width="64" height="6" rx="1" fill="#8B4513"/>
  
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="16" y="78" width="6" height="12" rx="2" fill="#6B3410"/>
  <rect x="78" y="78" width="6" height="12" rx="2" fill="#6B3410"/>
  
  <!-- Leg caps -->
  <rect x="14" y="86" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#D2B48C"/>
  <rect x="76" y="86" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#D2B48C"/>
  
  <!-- Wheel casters -->
  <circle cx="19" cy="93" r="3" fill="#B8860B"/>
  <circle cx="81" cy="93" r="3" fill="#B8860B"/>
  
  <!-- Cute cheek blush on piano lid -->
  <ellipse cx="25" cy="28" rx="5" ry="2.5" fill="#FFB6C1" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="75" cy="28" rx="5" ry="2.5" fill="#FFB6C1" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Small note decorations on music stand -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="19" r="1.5" fill="#4B0082"/>
  <rect x="44" y="15" width="1.5" height="5" fill="#4B0082"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#4B0082"/>
  <rect x="56" y="15" width="1.5" height="6" fill="#4B0082"/>
</svg>
